_note: len(hidden_channels) == len(kernel_sizes) sets the ConvLSTM stack depth; use _arch_pairs to keep the two synchronised. pool=2 with the 15x10 grid floor-divides 15x10 -> 7x5 -> 3x2 -> 1x1, so 3 layers is the deepest pool=2 supports. Archs picked to keep param counts <=~200k: 1-layer configs are excluded because pool=2 only fires once and the flatten -> dense head blows up (>=900k params even at width 8).
